test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to ₹9,648 in 4 years and to ₹11,484 in 7 years at the same rate percent per annum at simple interest. The sum is:
solution:
**Given:**

Amount in 4 years = ₹9,648

Amount in 7 years = ₹11,484

**Formula used:**

A = P + SI

**Calculation:**

Amount in 4 years = ₹9,648

Amount in 7 years = ₹11,484

SI in 3 years = 11,484 - 9,648 = 1836

SI in 1 years = 1836/3 = 612

SI in 4 years = 612 × 4 = 2448

For 4 years, A = P + SI

⇒ 9,648 = P + 2448

⇒ P = 9648 - 2448 = 7200

**∴ The sum is Rs. 7200.**
